see.prompt: Read the opening clock time. Identify il est and the plural heures used for eight o’clock.
see.targetText: Il est huit heures du matin.

recall.prompt: Recall the grammar-model sentence for one o’clock, keeping est singular.

hear.prompt: Listen for the number three in the afternoon study time.

type.prompt: Type when class begins, putting à before the scheduled hour.
type.targetText: Le cours commence à neuf heures.

say.prompt: Ask aloud what time your classmate gets home, beginning with À quelle heure.
say.targetText: À quelle heure arrives-tu à la maison ?

write.prompt: Write that you study at three in the afternoon, including de l’après-midi.
write.targetText: J’étudie à trois heures de l’après-midi.

see.prompt: Read Luis’s preference. Find n’…pas around the conjugated aimer.

recall.prompt: Recall the sentence saying we like studying together, with aimer followed by an infinitive.

hear.prompt: Listen for the plural noun meaning ‘books’ in Ana’s preference.

type.prompt: Type the sentence saying Ana likes books; the subject Ana determines aime.

say.prompt: Ask a classmate aloud whether they like these songs.

write.prompt: Write that you like music in general, keeping the definite article la.

see.prompt: Read the friends’ plan. Identify the plural veulent before the infinitive aller.
see.targetText: Mes amis veulent aller au parc.

recall.prompt: Recall the sentence saying we want to eat together, using voulons plus an infinitive.

hear.prompt: Listen for the noun meaning ‘home’ in Ana’s plan to rest.

type.prompt: Type that Ana wants to rest at home, using veut and the reflexive infinitive.
type.targetText: Ana veut se reposer à la maison.

say.prompt: Ask aloud whether your classmate wants to study before going out.
say.targetText: Tu veux étudier avant de sortir ?

write.prompt: Write that you want to visit your family, using rendre visite à.
write.targetText: Je veux rendre visite à ma famille.
